Syriatel requires a telecom-native CRM platform that manages the complete customer and subscriber lifecycle across retail, corporate, dealer, digital and service channels. The target solution is not only a traditional CRM; it is an enterprise CRM/BSS operating model integrating customer management, sales, subscription operations, provisioning, billing interactions, collections, fraud, revenue assurance, dealer operations, network-aware support and analytics.

Establish a unified customer and subscriber operating layer that improves service activation quality, customer experience, operational governance, revenue protection, dealer control and digital-service scalability.

Every customer, subscriber, SIM, order, device installment and complaint follows governed states and allowed transitions.
Eligibility, approval, rejection and escalation decisions are executed through transparent decision matrices.
CRM processes emit and consume events from billing, provisioning, inventory, network and payment systems.
Shared rules, validations, SLAs and fraud controls are centralized and referenced by processes to avoid duplication.
Critical data and lifecycle changes are logged with before/after values, actor, source channel and approval trace.
VIP, corporate, impacted-outage and high-risk customers receive differentiated routing and controls.
